category_status: Standard eight categories inferred from eight-category roto without turnovers; confirm exact categories.
season_mapping_status: Inferred from 11 consecutive league years and matching 2015-16 through 2025-26 tracking tabs.
roster_size_status: Observed in 163 of 165 team-seasons; lineup and bench rules unconfirmed.
budget_status: Confirmed by the supplied 2026 keeper summary: keeper costs plus remaining budget equal $200 for all 15 teams.
target_season_status: 2026 keeper summary supplied for the upcoming 2026-27 season.
elimination_schedule: First elimination a month and a bit into the season; then every one or two weeks until two teams remain. Exact dates not supplied.
eliminated_player_acquisition_rule: Eliminated rosters enter regular waivers. Unclaimed players enter a sniper draft in reverse original waiver order.
waiver_order_rule: Order selected before the season. No team repeats an earlier year's position within the 15-year cycle; reset in year 16. Actual orders not supplied.
historical_manager_identity: Sheet names identify franchise histories, not necessarily the manager in older seasons. Tracking headers are preserved separately.
